name: Auto Macro
displayDescription:
When enabled in settings, this feature automates the following actions:
- Auto Eating: Eats from your inventory when hunger drops below 30% (must have food).
- Auto XP Boost: Uses food that grants an XP boost.
- Auto Sleeping: Sleeps at 90% fatigue if near a bed (won’t sleep with Indomitable Will).
- Auto Equipment: Equips your best vests and weights.
- Auto Training: Trains continuously with the selected tool.
- Auto Logs: Automatically does Striking Logs, stops when below 10% health and switches to your previous training until you are back at 100% health.
- Persistence After Gripping: Keeps training after being gripped unless you lose your tools.
- Auto Rejoin: Rejoins every 18 minutes if AFK to keep the macro running. (? Server)
- Customizable Menu: A settings menu with various automation options.

(DOES NOT WORK WITH SHADOW BOXING)
You can store all your tools in your inventory, and the system will still work. Just activate training once, store the tool, and let it run!

name: Futuristic Hoverboard
displayDescription: Gives you the Futuristic Hoverboard Mount In-game

name: Portable Psyche Changer
displayDescription: Lets you change your psyche loadout from anywhere, as long as you aren't in combat.

name: Portable Card Rerolls
displayDescription: Reroll cards from any point of the map. Access from Ryujin Coins Shop.

name: Extra Emotes Slots
displayDescription: "Express yourself, now with double the options!" (Unlocks 4 extra slots for the emote wheel)

name: Private Arena
displayDescription:
Allows you to create a Private Arena server where you can fight with people in a separate area.
Data does not save in the Private Arena, so anything you do there will not carry over to the main game.
In the Private Arena you can do the following:
- Spawn Normal, Attacking, Blocking, and Perfect Blocking Dummies.
- Give and heal injuries.
- Heal your health and reset.
- Fill up Fighting Reflex and Evasive.
- Go to spectator stands.

name: Power Control
displayDescription: Allows individual control over your stats, changing them to any percentage you want.

name: Mode Outfit
displayDescription: Adds a new outfit slot that will automatically be equipped when you activate your mode.
